title: Than Hub
features:
Oi, Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

Than Hub is one key for every game we support. Paste the loadstring, verify your key once, and the loader detects the game and loads the right script for it. Built for mobile as well as PC!!

Supported right now: Fisch and Steal an Egg.

FISCH

* Auto Fishing - Enabled
* Auto Cast, Auto Shake, Instant Bobber, Instant Reel - Enabled
* Snap Reel - Enabled
* Auto Appraise, Auto Totem, Auto Enchant - Enabled
* Auto Favourite and Auto Storage - Enabled
* Auto Sell - Enabled
* Collect All Chests, Claim Starfall, Auto Star Crater - Enabled
* Shop buying: furniture, rods, totems, daily and black market - Enabled
* Teleport to locations, saved positions, whirlpools and players - Enabled
* TP On Death and Auto Rejoin - Enabled
* Walk On Water and NoClip - Toggle
* Anti-AFK - Toggle
* FPS Booster - Toggle
* Hide Identity and Anonymous Mode - Toggle
* Save, load and auto-save your config - Enabled

STEAL AN EGG

* Auto Steal with rarity, species, mutation and value targeting - Enabled
* Auto Place Eggs and Auto Hatch Ready - Enabled
* Auto Equip Best Pets, Auto Sell, Auto Favorite - Enabled
* Auto Fuse Pets - Enabled
* Auto Treadmill, Treadmill Upgrade and Base Upgrade - Enabled
* Auto Buy and Equip Best Trail - Enabled
* Auto Claim Index, Group Reward and Offline Earnings - Enabled
* Auto Pursue and Slap Carriers - Enabled
* Auto Gift and Auto Claim - Enabled
* Incubator: Auto Break Tree, Auto Deposit, Auto Select Egg - Enabled
* Auto Server Hop when the server empties - Enabled
* Egg, Carried Egg, Pet and Player ESP - Toggle
* Godmode and Noclip - Toggle
* FPS Boost and FPS Governor - Toggle
* Discord webhook alerts for spawns, hatches, pets, sales and summaries - Enabled
* Anonymous Mode - Toggle
